description: Task #3 GPU rigor (B200): the chunk_parallel scan_mode through the verifier's score_candidate_config (the config-RL reward path) on forward_chunked_scan. The full 12-gate battery runs at each bench shape; speedup is vs the shipped serial default; reward = 1 + clip(log speedup, 0, 3) after all contracts pass. chunk_len is auto-selected (largest divisor of seq_len <= cap) so the path never raises on the gate battery's varied/odd shapes and still picks a coarse, fast granularity at long L.
finding: chunk_parallel is contract-clean (passes all 12 gates, 0 failures) AND genuinely beats the hand-written serial kernel through the verified reward: 7.29x at L=16384, 3.46x at L=4096, 1.33x at L=2048 — reward up to 2.99 vs serial's ~1.0. This is an algorithmic-mode config-RL action (scan_mode) that beats the hand-written baseline, not just launch-knob tuning. The reward gradient (≈3.0 vs 1.0) is decisive, so a config-RL policy learns to select chunk_parallel at long L.
key_finding_before_fix: A fixed large chunk_len (128/256/512) FAILED the gate battery (CMP-03/CMP-01 probe odd/small seq_lens the launcher could not divide -> raise); chunk_len inheriting the harness chunk_size=8 PASSED gates but was 0.28x (the Python O(n_chunks) carry dominates). _auto_chunk_len(seq_len, requested) = largest divisor <= target resolved both.
